title: Business Partnership Calculator: honest founder synergy
subtitle: A short business setup, quick or full questionnaire, and a report with metrics plus founders-agreement prompts.
seoTitle: Business Partnership Calculator | Founders Assessment | DailyLogic
seoDescription: Honest business partnership calculator: setup wizard, quick or 30 deep industry-aware questions, synergy metrics, tips, and founders-agreement prompts — free in your browser.
heroDescription: Partnerships break on money, ego, invisible load, and exit — not slogans. This calculator collects context, asks honest questions (including industry twists), and produces a synergy profile with founders-agreement recommendations.

sections.heading: What the Business Partnership Calculator does
paragraphs: Before the quiz, you set status, partner count, industry, and equity split — tuning wording and emphasis. Then choose quick or full depth.
Questions hit what actually breaks partnerships: failure ownership, cashflow, decisions, invisible work, and future exit — with industry variants.
The report includes metrics, insights, tips, and clauses worth putting in a founders agreement. Everything stays local in your browser.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Complete the setup wizard, pick questionnaire length, and answer on a frequency scale while watching the progress bar.
Save results to history (with Expand on the home page), or download/copy a result card.
Use the report as a founders conversation starter — not a verdict.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Most business conflicts come from ambiguity, not malice. Writing early prevents expensive drama.
Industry-aware prompts help touch real sensitive points (IP in tech, inventory in commerce, clients in services).
Retaking after a quarter can show whether alignment actually happened.

benefits.title: Setup wizard
benefits.description: Status, partners, industry, and equity shape what follows.

benefits.title: Two lengths
benefits.description: Quick for speed or full depth for a serious read.

benefits.title: Founders agreement
benefits.description: Insights and clauses worth putting in writing.

faq.question: Do we need to already be partners?
faq.answer: No. You can also use the considering-partnership mode — wording adapts.

faq.question: Is data sent to a server?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs and saves locally in your browser.

faq.question: Does this replace a lawyer?
faq.answer: No. It’s an alignment tool and checklist — not legal advice.
